- **The player starts itself.** On AnimeWorld the video only appears after you
  click a cover on the page. Play, seek and fullscreen from the remote now press
  it first, wait for the video and then do what you asked, in Skipper Screen
  (Chrome and Brave) and in the browser extension. Ad popups opened by that
  click are closed.
- **Brave works.** Skipper Screen now has episode navigation and player start
  for Brave. Brave ignores the accessibility "click" on web pages while a real
  tap works, so every press is now checked for an effect and retried as a tap
  when nothing happened. Nothing is reported as done unless the page changed.
- **Slow starts no longer look like failures.** The remote waits up to 20 s for
  play, seek, fullscreen and episode changes instead of 6 s.
- **Faster releases.** Builds restore their compiler caches (they used to
  expire between releases) and skip lint, which took a third of the Android
  build.
